```text
1	import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
2	import { castNumber } from "../../../lib/cast-number"
3	import { ProductCreateSchemaType } from "./types"
4	
5	export const normalizeProductFormValues = (
6	  values: ProductCreateSchemaType & {
7	    status: HttpTypes.AdminProductStatus
8	    regionsCurrencyMap: Record<string, string>
9	  }
10	): HttpTypes.AdminCreateProduct => {
11	  const thumbnail = values.media?.find((media) => media.isThumbnail)?.url
12	  const images = values.media
13	    ?.filter((media) => !media.isThumbnail)
14	    .map((media) => ({ url: media.url }))
15	
16	  const options = values.options.filter((o) => o.title) // clean temp. values
17	
18	  return {
19	    status: values.status,
20	    is_giftcard: false,
21	    tags: values?.tags?.length
22	      ? values.tags?.map((tag) => ({ id: tag }))
23	      : undefined,
24	    sales_channels: values?.sales_channels?.length
25	      ? values.sales_channels?.map((sc) => ({ id: sc.id }))
26	      : undefined,
27	    images,
28	    collection_id: values.collection_id || undefined,
29	    shipping_profile_id: values.shipping_profile_id || undefined,
30	    categories: values.categories.map((id) => ({ id })),
31	    type_id: values.type_id || undefined,
32	    handle: values.handle?.trim(),
33	    origin_country: values.origin_country || undefined,
34	    material: values.material || undefined,
35	    mid_code: values.mid_code || undefined,
36	    hs_code: values.hs_code || undefined,
37	    thumbnail,
38	    title: values.title.trim(),
39	    subtitle: values.subtitle?.trim(),
40	    description: values.description?.trim(),
41	    discountable: values.discountable,
42	    width: values.width ? parseFloat(values.width) : undefined,
43	    length: values.length ? parseFloat(values.length) : undefined,
44	    height: values.height ? parseFloat(values.height) : undefined,
45	    weight: values.weight ? parseFloat(values.weight) : undefined,
46	    options: options.map((option) => {
47	      const { id, value_ids, ...rest } = option
48	      return id ? { id, value_ids } : { ...rest, is_exclusive: true }
49	    }),
50	    variants: normalizeVariants(
51	      values.variants.filter((variant) => variant.should_create),
52	      values.regionsCurrencyMap
53	    ),
54	  }
55	}
56	
57	export const normalizeVariants = (
58	  variants: ProductCreateSchemaType["variants"],
59	  regionsCurrencyMap: Record<string, string>
60	): HttpTypes.AdminCreateProductVariant[] => {
61	  return variants.map((variant) => ({
62	    title: variant.title || Object.values(variant.options || {}).join(" / "),
63	    options: variant.options,
64	    sku: variant.sku || undefined,
65	    manage_inventory: !!variant.manage_inventory,
66	    allow_backorder: !!variant.allow_backorder,
67	    variant_rank: variant.variant_rank,
68	    inventory_items: variant
69	      .inventory!.map((i) => {
70	        const quantity = i.required_quantity
71	          ? castNumber(i.required_quantity)
72	          : null
73	
74	        if (!i.inventory_item_id || !quantity) {
75	          return false
76	        }
77	
78	        return {
79	          ...i,
80	          required_quantity: quantity,
81	        }
82	      })
83	      .filter(
84	        (
85	          item
86	        ): item is { required_quantity: number; inventory_item_id: string } =>
87	          item !== false
88	      ),
89	    prices: Object.entries(variant.prices || {})
90	      .map(([key, value]: any) => {
91	        if (value === "" || value === undefined) {
92	          return undefined
93	        }
94	
95	        if (key.startsWith("reg_")) {
96	          return {
97	            currency_code: regionsCurrencyMap[key],
98	            amount: castNumber(value),
99	            rules: { region_id: key },
100	          }
101	        } else {
102	          return {
103	            currency_code: key,
104	            amount: castNumber(value),
105	          }
106	        }
107	      })
108	      .filter((v) => !!v),
109	  }))
110	}
111	
112	export const decorateVariantsWithDefaultValues = (
113	  variants: ProductCreateSchemaType["variants"]
114	) => {
115	  return variants.map((variant) => ({
116	    ...variant,
117	    title: variant.title || "",
118	    sku: variant.sku || "",
119	    manage_inventory: variant.manage_inventory || false,
120	    allow_backorder: variant.allow_backorder || false,
121	    inventory_kit: variant.inventory_kit || false,
122	  }))
123	}
```

```text
  .transform((value) => {
    if (value === "") {
      return null
    }
    return Number(value)
  })
  .optional()
  .nullable()

const ProductAttributesSchema = zod.object({
  weight: dimension,
  length: dimension,
  width: dimension,
  height: dimension,
  mid_code: zod.string().optional(),
  hs_code: zod.string().optional(),
  origin_country: zod.string().optional(),
})

export const ProductAttributesForm = ({
  product,
}: ProductAttributesFormProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { handleSuccess } = useRouteModal()
  const { getFormConfigs, getFormFields } = useExtension()

  const configs = getFormConfigs("product", "attributes")
  const fields = getFormFields("product", "attributes")

  const form = useExtendableForm({
    defaultValues: {
      height: product.height ? product.height : null,
      width: product.width ? product.width : null,
      length: product.length ? product.length : null,
      weight: product.weight ? product.weight : null,
      mid_code: product.mid_code || "",
      hs_code: product.hs_code || "",
      origin_country: product.origin_country || "",
    },
    schema: ProductAttributesSchema,
    configs: configs,
    data: product,
  })

  const { mutateAsync, isPending } = useUpdateProduct(product.id)

  const handleSubmit = form.handleSubmit(async (data) => {
    await mutateAsync(
      {
        weight: data.weight ? data.weight : null,
        length: data.length ? data.length : null,
        width: data.width ? data.width : null,
        height: data.height ? data.height : null,
        mid_code: data.mid_code,
        hs_code: data.hs_code,
        origin_country: data.origin_country || null,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          handleSuccess()
        },
      }
    )
  })

  return (
```

```text
export const ProductEdit = () => {
  const { id } = useParams()
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const { product, isLoading, isError, error } = useProduct(id!, {
    // TODO: Remove exclusion once we avoid including unnecessary relations by default in the query config
    fields:
      "-type,-collection,-options,-tags,-images,-variants,-sales_channels",
  })

  if (isError) {
    throw error
  }

  return (
    <RouteDrawer>
      <RouteDrawer.Header>
        <RouteDrawer.Title asChild>
          <Heading>{t("products.edit.header")}</Heading>
        </RouteDrawer.Title>
        <RouteDrawer.Description className="sr-only">
          {t("products.edit.description")}
        </RouteDrawer.Description>
      </RouteDrawer.Header>
      {!isLoading && product && <EditProductForm product={product} />}
    </RouteDrawer>
  )
}

export const ProductCreateMediaSection = ({
  form,
}: ProductCreateMediaSectionProps) => {
  const { fields, append, remove } = useFieldArray({
    name: "media",
    control: form.control,
    keyName: "field_id",
  })

  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<UniqueIdentifier | null>(null)

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
    })
  )

  const handleDragStart = (event: DragStartEvent) => {
    setActiveId(event.active.id)
  }

  const handleDragEnd = (event: DragEndEvent) => {
    setActiveId(null)
    const { active, over } = event

    if (active.id !== over?.id) {
      const oldIndex = fields.findIndex((item) => item.field_id === active.id)
      const newIndex = fields.findIndex((item) => item.field_id === over?.id)

      form.setValue("media", arrayMove(fields, oldIndex, newIndex), {
        shouldDirty: true,
        shouldTouch: true,
      })
    }
  }

  const handleDragCancel = () => {
    setActiveId(null)
  }

  const getOnDelete = (index: number) => {
    return () => {
      remove(index)
    }
  }

  const getMakeThumbnail = (index: number) => {
    return () => {
      const newFields = fields.map((field, i) => {
        return {
          ...field,
          isThumbnail: i === index,
        }
      })

      form.setValue("media", newFields, {
        shouldDirty: true,
        shouldTouch: true,
      })
    }
  }
```

```text
import { castNumber } from "./cast-number"

export function transformNullableFormValue<T>(
  value: T,
  nullify = true
): T | undefined | null {
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "") {
    return nullify ? null : undefined
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0) {
    return nullify ? null : undefined
  }

  return value
}

type Nullable<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] | null }
type Optional<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] | undefined }

export function transformNullableFormData<
  T extends Record<string, unknown>,
  K extends boolean = true
>(data: T, nullify: K = true as K): K extends true ? Nullable<T> : Optional<T> {
  return Object.entries(data).reduce((acc, [key, value]) => {
    return {
      ...acc,
      [key]: transformNullableFormValue(value, nullify),
    }
  }, {} as K extends true ? Nullable<T> : Optional<T>)
}

export function transformNullableFormNumber<K extends boolean = true>(
  value?: string | number,
  nullify: K = true as K
): K extends true ? number | null : number | undefined {
  if (
    typeof value === "undefined" ||
    (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "")
  ) {
    return (nullify ? null : undefined) as K extends true
      ? number | null
      : number | undefined
  }

  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return castNumber(value)
  }

  return value
}

type NullableNumbers = Record<string, number | null>
type OptionalNumbers = Record<string, number | undefined>

  T extends Record<string, string | number | undefined>,
  K extends boolean = true
>(

/**
 * Helper function to cast a z.union([z.number(), z.string()]) to a number
 */
export const castNumber = (number: number | string) => {
  return typeof number === "string" ? Number(number.replace(",", ".")) : number
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { castNumber } from "../../../lib/cast-number"
import { transformNullableFormNumber } from "../../../lib/form-helpers"
import { ProductCreateSchemaType } from "../product-create/types"

/**
 * Helpers for the full "Edit Product" flow.
 *
 * The edit flow deliberately re-uses the create flow's form schema
 * (`ProductCreateSchema`) and its tab components. That means everything in this
 * file is about translating between two shapes:
 *
 *   product returned by the API  --mapProductToFormValues-->  form values
 *   form values                  --buildProductEditRequests-->  API payloads
 *
 * All functions here are pure (no network, no React), which keeps them easy to
 * unit test and to review.
 */

/**
 * The fields we ask the API for when loading the product into the edit form.
 * The default product detail query omits several relations (variants, options,
 * images, ...) so we list everything the form needs explicitly.
 */
export const PRODUCT_EDIT_FULL_FIELDS = [
  "*variants",
  "*variants.prices",
  "*variants.options",
  "*variants.inventory_items",
  "*options",
  "*options.values",
  "*images",
  "*tags",
  "*categories",
  "*sales_channels",
  "*shipping_profile",
  "*type",
  "*collection",
].join(",")

/**
 * The API can return extra fields that the generated `HttpTypes` don't declare
 * (price rules, option ids on option values, inventory kit rows). This type
 * describes just the extras we read, so we avoid scattering `any` casts.
 */
type EditableVariant = HttpTypes.AdminProductVariant & {
  prices?: (HttpTypes.AdminProductVariantPrice & {
    rules?: Record<string, string>
  })[]
  inventory_items?: {
    inventory_item_id: string
    required_quantity: number
  }[]
  options?: (HttpTypes.AdminProductOptionValue & {
    option_id?: string
    option?: { title?: string }
  })[]
}

type EditableProduct = Omit<HttpTypes.AdminProduct, "variants"> & {
  variants?: EditableVariant[] | null
  shipping_profile?: { id: string } | null
}

/**
 * Variants in the form are identified only by their position (zod strips the
 * `id` because the create schema has no such field). Both the mapping into the
 * form and the diffing on save therefore go through this one function so the
 * order is guaranteed to be identical in both directions.
 */
export const getSortedVariants = (product: EditableProduct) =>
  [...(product.variants ?? [])].sort(
    (a, b) => (a.variant_rank ?? 0) - (b.variant_rank ?? 0)
  )

/**
 * Builds the form's `media` array from the product's images and thumbnail.
 * This mirrors `getDefaultValues` in the media edit form: the product stores
 * the thumbnail as a plain URL, so we flag the matching image, and if the
 * thumbnail is not among the images we add it as an extra entry.
 */
const getMediaDefaults = (product: EditableProduct) => {
  const media: ProductCreateSchemaType["media"] = (product.images ?? []).map(
    (image) => ({
      id: image.id,
      url: image.url,
      isThumbnail: image.url === product.thumbnail,
      file: null, // null means "already uploaded"; only new files carry a File
    })
  )

  if (
    product.thumbnail &&
    !media.some((item) => item.url === product.thumbnail)
  ) {
    media.unshift({
      url: product.thumbnail,
      isThumbnail: true,
      file: null,
    })
  }

  return media
}

/**
 * Maps one stored variant to one entry of the form's `variants` array.
 * Exported separately so `buildProductEditRequests` can recompute the
 * "initial" value of a variant and detect whether the user changed it.
 */
export const mapVariantToFormValue = (
  variant: EditableVariant,
  optionTitlesById: Record<string, string>
): ProductCreateSchemaType["variants"][number] => {
  // The form keys a variant's option values by option *title*.
  const options = (variant.options ?? []).reduce((acc, optionValue) => {
    const title =
      optionValue.option?.title ??
      (optionValue.option_id ? optionTitlesById[optionValue.option_id] : "")

    if (title) {
      acc[title] = optionValue.value
    }
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, string>)

  // Prices are keyed by region id (region prices) or currency code (plain
  // prices); this is the same convention the price editor uses.
  const prices = (variant.prices ?? []).reduce((acc, price) => {
    const key = price.rules?.region_id ?? price.currency_code
    acc[key] = String(price.amount)
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, string>)

  const kitItems = variant.inventory_items ?? []

  // A variant is treated as an "inventory kit" when it maps to more than one
  // inventory item, or to a single item that needs more than one unit.
  const isKit =
    kitItems.length > 1 ||
    (kitItems.length === 1 && kitItems[0].required_quantity !== 1)

  return {
    should_create: true, // every existing variant stays visible in the grid
    title: variant.title ?? "",
    sku: variant.sku ?? "",
    manage_inventory: !!variant.manage_inventory,
    allow_backorder: !!variant.allow_backorder,
    inventory_kit: isKit,
    options,
    variant_rank: variant.variant_rank ?? 0,
    prices,
    inventory: kitItems.length
      ? kitItems.map((item) => ({
          inventory_item_id: item.inventory_item_id,
          required_quantity: String(item.required_quantity),
        }))
      : [{ inventory_item_id: "", required_quantity: "" }],
  }
}

/**
 * Inverse of `normalizeProductFormValues` (create flow): turns a stored product
 * into the form values used to pre-fill every field of the edit flow.
 */
export const mapProductToFormValues = (
  product: EditableProduct
): ProductCreateSchemaType => {
  const options = (product.options ?? []).map((option) => ({
    id: option.id,
    title: option.title,
    values: (option.values ?? []).map((v) => v.value),
    value_ids: (option.values ?? []).map((v) => v.id),
  }))

  const optionTitlesById = options.reduce((acc, option) => {
    acc[option.id!] = option.title
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, string>)

  return {
    title: product.title ?? "",
    subtitle: product.subtitle ?? "",
    handle: product.handle ?? "",
    description: product.description ?? "",
    discountable: !!product.discountable,
    type_id: product.type_id ?? "",
    collection_id: product.collection_id ?? "",
    shipping_profile_id: product.shipping_profile?.id ?? "",
    categories: (product.categories ?? []).map((c) => c.id),
    tags: (product.tags ?? []).map((t) => t.id),
    sales_channels: (product.sales_channels ?? []).map((sc) => ({
      id: sc.id,
      name: sc.name,
    })),
    origin_country: product.origin_country ?? "",
    material: product.material ?? "",
    // Dimensions are numbers in the API but strings in the form inputs.
    width: product.width != null ? String(product.width) : "",
    length: product.length != null ? String(product.length) : "",
    height: product.height != null ? String(product.height) : "",
    weight: product.weight != null ? String(product.weight) : "",
    mid_code: product.mid_code ?? "",
    hs_code: product.hs_code ?? "",
    options,
    // Not used by the edit flow (variants/options are edit-in-place only), but
    // required by the shared schema.
    enable_variants: (product.variants?.length ?? 0) > 1,
    variants: getSortedVariants(product).map((variant) =>
      mapVariantToFormValue(variant, optionTitlesById)
    ),
    media: getMediaDefaults(product),
  }
}

/**
 * Everything the save handler needs to send, already split per endpoint.
 * `undefined` for a key means "nothing changed, skip that call".
 */
export type ProductEditRequests = {
  variantUpdates?: HttpTypes.AdminBatchProductVariantRequest["update"]
  inventoryItems?: HttpTypes.AdminBatchProductVariantInventoryItemRequest
  product: HttpTypes.AdminUpdateProduct
}

/**
 * Converts the submitted form values into the payloads for the three API calls
 * made on save (see `ProductEditFullForm` for the order they run in).
 *
 * @param values - the validated form values
 * @param product - the product as it was loaded; used to find variant ids and
 *   to skip variants the user did not touch
 * @param media - the form's media after new files were uploaded, i.e. every
 *   entry has a final `url`
 * @param regionsCurrencyMap - region id -> currency code, for region prices
 */
export const buildProductEditRequests = ({
  values,
  product,
  media,
  regionsCurrencyMap,
}: {
  values: ProductCreateSchemaType
  product: EditableProduct
  media: { id?: string; url: string; isThumbnail: boolean }[]
  regionsCurrencyMap: Record<string, string>
}): ProductEditRequests => {
  const initial = mapProductToFormValues(product)
  const storedVariants = getSortedVariants(product)

  const variantUpdates: NonNullable<ProductEditRequests["variantUpdates"]> = []
  const inventoryCreate: { variant_id: string; inventory_item_id: string; required_quantity: number }[] = []
  const inventoryUpdate: { variant_id: string; inventory_item_id: string; required_quantity: number }[] = []
  const inventoryDelete: { variant_id: string; inventory_item_id: string }[] = []

  values.variants.forEach((variant, index) => {
    const stored = storedVariants[index]
    const before = initial.variants[index]

    // Defensive: the grid never adds or removes rows, so this should not
    // happen, but never send an update for a variant we cannot identify.
    if (!stored || !before) {
      return
    }

    // --- Variant fields (title, sku, flags, prices) --------------------------
    // Compare field by field against the initial values so untouched variants
    // do not generate any request.
    const variantFieldsChanged =
      variant.title !== before.title ||
      (variant.sku ?? "") !== (before.sku ?? "") ||
      !!variant.manage_inventory !== !!before.manage_inventory ||
      !!variant.allow_backorder !== !!before.allow_backorder ||
      JSON.stringify(variant.prices ?? {}) !== JSON.stringify(before.prices)

    if (variantFieldsChanged) {
      variantUpdates.push({
        id: stored.id,
        title: variant.title,
        // An emptied SKU input means "remove the SKU", so send null.
        sku: variant.sku ? variant.sku : null,
        manage_inventory: !!variant.manage_inventory,
        allow_backorder: !!variant.allow_backorder,
        prices: buildPricePayload(
          variant.prices ?? {},
          stored,
          regionsCurrencyMap
        ),
      })
    }

    // --- Inventory kit ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Only diff the kit when the user has the variant marked as a kit; this
    // matches the create flow, where the inventory tab only applies to kits.
    if (variant.manage_inventory && variant.inventory_kit) {
      const desired = (variant.inventory ?? [])
        .map((item) => ({
          inventory_item_id: item.inventory_item_id,
          required_quantity: item.required_quantity
            ? castNumber(item.required_quantity)
            : 0,
        }))
        // Skip the blank placeholder row the form keeps for new entries.
        .filter((item) => item.inventory_item_id && item.required_quantity)

      const current = stored.inventory_items ?? []

      desired.forEach((item) => {
        const existing = current.find(
          (c) => c.inventory_item_id === item.inventory_item_id
        )

        if (!existing) {
          inventoryCreate.push({ variant_id: stored.id, ...item })
        } else if (existing.required_quantity !== item.required_quantity) {
          inventoryUpdate.push({ variant_id: stored.id, ...item })
        }
      })

      current.forEach((c) => {
        if (!desired.some((d) => d.inventory_item_id === c.inventory_item_id)) {
          inventoryDelete.push({
            variant_id: stored.id,
            inventory_item_id: c.inventory_item_id,
          })
        }
      })
    }
  })

  const hasInventoryChanges =
    inventoryCreate.length || inventoryUpdate.length || inventoryDelete.length

  return {
    variantUpdates: variantUpdates.length ? variantUpdates : undefined,
    inventoryItems: hasInventoryChanges
      ? {
          create: inventoryCreate,
          update: inventoryUpdate,
          delete: inventoryDelete,
        }
      : undefined,
    product: {
      title: values.title.trim(),
      // Empty strings become null so the API clears the value instead of
      // storing an empty string.
      subtitle: values.subtitle?.trim() || null,
      description: values.description?.trim() || null,
      handle: values.handle.trim(),
      discountable: values.discountable,
      type_id: values.type_id || null,
      collection_id: values.collection_id || null,
      categories: values.categories.map((id) => ({ id })),
      tags: (values.tags ?? []).map((id) => ({ id })),
      sales_channels: (values.sales_channels ?? []).map((sc) => ({
        id: sc.id,
      })),
      // The API cannot unset a shipping profile, so only send it when set.
      ...(values.shipping_profile_id
        ? { shipping_profile_id: values.shipping_profile_id }
        : {}),
      images: media.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, url: m.url })),
      thumbnail: media.find((m) => m.isThumbnail)?.url ?? null,
      origin_country: values.origin_country || null,
      material: values.material || null,
      mid_code: values.mid_code || null,
      hs_code: values.hs_code || null,
      width: transformNullableFormNumber(values.width),
      length: transformNullableFormNumber(values.length),
      height: transformNullableFormNumber(values.height),
      weight: transformNullableFormNumber(values.weight),
    },
  }
}

/**
 * Converts the form's price record (keyed by region id or currency code) into
 * the API's price array, re-using the id of an existing price so the API
 * updates it instead of creating a duplicate. Cleared cells are dropped.
 * Same logic as `product-prices/pricing-edit.tsx`.
 */
const buildPricePayload = (
  prices: Record<string, string | number | undefined>,
  stored: EditableVariant,
  regionsCurrencyMap: Record<string, string>
): HttpTypes.AdminUpdateProductVariantPrice[] => {
  return Object.entries(prices)
    .filter(([, value]) => value !== "" && typeof value !== "undefined")
    .map(([key, value]) => {
      const isRegion = key.startsWith("reg_")
      const currencyCode = isRegion ? regionsCurrencyMap[key] : key

      const existing = (stored.prices ?? []).find((p) =>
        isRegion
          ? p.rules?.region_id === key
          : p.currency_code === currencyCode &&
            Object.keys(p.rules ?? {}).length === 0
      )

      return {
        id: existing?.id,
        currency_code: currencyCode,
        amount: castNumber(value as string | number),
        ...(isRegion ? { rules: { region_id: key } } : {}),
      }
    })
}
```

```text
import { Prompt } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { PropsWithChildren } from "react"
import { FieldValues, UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"
import { useBlocker } from "react-router-dom"
import { Form } from "../../common/form"

type RouteModalFormProps<TFieldValues extends FieldValues> = PropsWithChildren<{
  form: UseFormReturn<TFieldValues>
  blockSearchParams?: boolean
  onClose?: (isSubmitSuccessful: boolean) => void
}>

export const RouteModalForm = <TFieldValues extends FieldValues = any>({
  form,
  blockSearchParams: blockSearch = false,
  children,
  onClose,
}: RouteModalFormProps<TFieldValues>) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const {
    formState: { isDirty },
  } = form

  const blocker = useBlocker(({ currentLocation, nextLocation }) => {
    // Check both nextLocation and currentLocation state for successful submission
    // This handles browser history navigation (-1) where we set state on current location
    const { isSubmitSuccessful: nextIsSuccessful } = nextLocation.state || {}
    const { isSubmitSuccessful: currentIsSuccessful } =
      currentLocation.state || {}
    const isSubmitSuccessful = nextIsSuccessful || currentIsSuccessful

    if (isSubmitSuccessful) {
      onClose?.(true)
      return false
    }

    const isPathChanged = currentLocation.pathname !== nextLocation.pathname
    const isSearchChanged = currentLocation.search !== nextLocation.search

    if (blockSearch) {
      const shouldBlock = isDirty && (isPathChanged || isSearchChanged)

      if (isPathChanged) {
        onClose?.(isSubmitSuccessful)
      }

      return shouldBlock
    }

    const shouldBlock = isDirty && isPathChanged

    if (isPathChanged) {
      onClose?.(isSubmitSuccessful)
    }

    return shouldBlock
  })
```

```typescript
import {
  productsQueryKeys,
  useProductVariantsInventoryItemsBatch,
  useUpdateProduct,
  useUpdateProductVariantsBatch,
} from "../../../../../hooks/api/products"
import { useDocumentDirection } from "../../../../../hooks/use-document-direction"
import { sdk } from "../../../../../lib/client"
import { queryClient } from "../../../../../lib/query-client"
import { useExtension } from "../../../../../providers/extension-provider"
// The edit flow re-uses the create flow's schema and tab components so both
// flows stay visually identical and share one set of validations.
import { ProductCreateInventoryKitForm } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-inventory-kit-form"
import { ProductCreateDetailsForm } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-details-form"
import { ProductCreateGeneralSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-details-form/components/product-create-details-general-section"
import { ProductCreateMediaSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-details-form/components/product-create-details-media-section"
import { ProductCreateOrganizeForm } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-organize-form"
import { ProductCreateAttributeSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-organize-form/components/product-create-organize-attribute-section"
import { ProductCreateVariantsForm } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-variants-form"
import { ProductCreateSchema } from "../../../product-create/constants"
import { buildProductEditRequests, mapProductToFormValues } from "../../utils"

enum Tab {
  DETAILS = "details",
  ORGANIZE = "organize",
  VARIANTS = "variants",
  INVENTORY = "inventory",
}

type ProductEditFullFormProps = {
  product: HttpTypes.AdminProduct
  regions: HttpTypes.AdminRegion[]
  store: HttpTypes.AdminStore
  pricePreferences: HttpTypes.AdminPricePreference[]
}

export const ProductEditFullForm = ({
  product,
  regions,
  store,
  pricePreferences,
}: ProductEditFullFormProps) => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>(Tab.DETAILS)

  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { handleSuccess } = useRouteModal()
  const { getFormConfigs } = useExtension()
  const direction = useDocumentDirection()

  // Pre-fill every field from the stored product (acceptance criterion 3).
  // `RouteFocusModal.Form` below watches this form's dirty state and shows the
  // "unsaved changes" prompt if the user tries to leave, so closing the modal
  // without saving never writes anything (criterion 6).
  const form = useExtendableForm({
    defaultValues: mapProductToFormValues(product),
    schema: ProductCreateSchema,
    configs: getFormConfigs("product", "create"),
  })

  const updateVariants = useUpdateProductVariantsBatch(product.id)
  const updateInventoryItems = useProductVariantsInventoryItemsBatch(product.id)
  const updateProduct = useUpdateProduct(product.id)
  const isPending =
    updateVariants.isPending ||
    updateInventoryItems.isPending ||
    updateProduct.isPending

  const regionsCurrencyMap = useMemo(
    () =>
      regions.reduce((acc, region) => {
        acc[region.id] = region.currency_code
        return acc
      }, {} as Record<string, string>),
    [regions]
  )

  // The inventory-kit tab only matters when at least one variant is a kit.
  const watchedVariants = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: "variants" })
  const showInventoryTab = useMemo(
    () => watchedVariants.some((v) => v.manage_inventory && v.inventory_kit),
    [watchedVariants]
  )

  const tabs = useMemo(
    () =>
      [
        Tab.DETAILS,
        Tab.ORGANIZE,
        Tab.VARIANTS,
        ...(showInventoryTab ? [Tab.INVENTORY] : []),
      ] as Tab[],
    [showInventoryTab]
  )
  const isLastTab = tab === tabs[tabs.length - 1]

  // Tabs before the current one are "completed", the current one is
  // "in-progress", the rest are "not-started".
  const getTabState = (value: Tab): ProgressStatus => {
    const current = tabs.indexOf(tab)
    const index = tabs.indexOf(value)

    if (index < current) {
      return "completed"
    }

    return index === current ? "in-progress" : "not-started"
  }

  /**
   * Save handler. Nothing is sent to the server until this runs (criterion 5).
   *
   * Saving is several requests because no single endpoint can update product
   * fields, variants, prices and inventory kits together. The order is chosen
   * so the requests most likely to be rejected by validation (variant
   * SKUs/prices) run first and the product update runs last; if an early
   * request fails we stop before touching the product itself.
   */
  const handleSubmit = form.handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    // Step 1: upload any newly added files. Entries that already have a URL
    // (existing images) have `file: null` and are left alone.
    const media = values.media ?? []
    const newFiles = media
      .map((m, index) => ({ file: m.file as File | null, index }))
      .filter((m) => !!m.file)

    let uploadedUrls: string[] = []

    if (newFiles.length) {
      try {
        const { files } = await sdk.admin.upload.create({
          files: newFiles.map((m) => m.file!),
        })
        uploadedUrls = files.map((f) => f.url)
      } catch (e) {
        // Unlike the create flow we stop here: carrying on would silently
        // drop the images the user just added.
        toast.error(t("products.media.failedToUpload"))
        return
      }
    }

    // Swap each new file's temporary preview URL for the uploaded URL.
    const resolvedMedia = media.map((m, index) => {
      const uploadIndex = newFiles.findIndex((f) => f.index === index)
      return uploadIndex > -1 ? { ...m, url: uploadedUrls[uploadIndex] } : m
    })

    // Step 2: work out what actually changed and build the payloads.
    const requests = buildProductEditRequests({
      values,
      product,
      media: resolvedMedia,
      regionsCurrencyMap,
    })

    try {
      // Step 3: variant fields + prices (skipped if no variant changed).
      if (requests.variantUpdates) {
        await updateVariants.mutateAsync(requests.variantUpdates)
      }

      // Step 4: inventory kit links (skipped if no kit changed).
      if (requests.inventoryItems) {
        await updateInventoryItems.mutateAsync(requests.inventoryItems)
      }

      // Step 5: the product itself, last.
      await updateProduct.mutateAsync(requests.product)
    } catch (e) {
      // Earlier requests may already have been saved, so refetch the product
      // to make sure the page reflects what is really stored, and keep the
      // modal open so the user can retry.
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: productsQueryKeys.detail(product.id),
      })

      toast.error(t("products.edit.full.errorToast"), {
        description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
      })
      return
    }

    toast.success(
      t("products.edit.successToast", { title: values.title.trim() })
    )

    // No argument: close the modal and return to the product detail page.
    handleSuccess()
  })

  // Validate before moving on so errors surface on the tab where they occur.
  const onNext = async () => {
    if (!(await form.trigger())) {
      return
    }

    setTab(tabs[tabs.indexOf(tab) + 1])
  }

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal.Form form={form}>
      <KeyboundForm
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          // Enter must not submit the form half-way through the flow.
          if (e.key !== "Enter") {
            return
          }

          if (
            e.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement &&
            !(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)
          ) {
            return
          }

          e.preventDefault()

          // Cmd/Ctrl+Enter advances, or saves on the last tab.
          if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) {
            if (isLastTab) {
              handleSubmit()
            } else {
              e.stopPropagation()
              onNext()
            }
          }
        }}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="flex h-full flex-col"
      >
        <ProgressTabs
          dir={direction}
          value={tab}
          onValueChange={async (next) => {
            if (await form.trigger()) {
              setTab(next as Tab)
            }
          }}
          className="flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden"
        >
          <RouteFocusModal.Header>
            <div className="-my-2 w-full border-l">
              <ProgressTabs.List className="justify-start-start flex w-full items-center">
                {tabs.map((value) => (
                  <ProgressTabs.Trigger
                    key={value}
                    status={getTabState(value)}
                    value={value}
                    className="max-w-[200px] truncate"
                  >
                    {t(`products.create.tabs.${value}`)}
                  </ProgressTabs.Trigger>
                ))}
              </ProgressTabs.List>
            </div>
          </RouteFocusModal.Header>
          <RouteFocusModal.Body className="size-full overflow-hidden">
            <ProgressTabs.Content
              className="size-full overflow-y-auto"
              value={Tab.DETAILS}
            >
              <DetailsTab form={form} />
            </ProgressTabs.Content>
            <ProgressTabs.Content
              className="size-full overflow-y-auto"
              value={Tab.ORGANIZE}
            >
              <ProductCreateOrganizeForm form={form} />
              {/* The create flow leaves attributes (dimensions, material,
                  origin, HS/MID codes) out. The edit flow needs them so a
                  manager can change shipping dimensions in the same session. */}
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-16 pb-16">
                <div className="w-full max-w-[720px]">
                  <ProductCreateAttributeSection form={form} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </ProgressTabs.Content>
            <ProgressTabs.Content
              className="size-full overflow-y-auto"
              value={Tab.VARIANTS}
            >
              <ProductCreateVariantsForm
                form={form}
                store={store}
                regions={regions}
                pricePreferences={pricePreferences}
              />
            </ProgressTabs.Content>
            {showInventoryTab && (
              <ProgressTabs.Content
                className="size-full overflow-y-auto"
                value={Tab.INVENTORY}
              >
                <ProductCreateInventoryKitForm form={form} />
              </ProgressTabs.Content>
            )}
          </RouteFocusModal.Body>
        </ProgressTabs>
        <RouteFocusModal.Footer>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-x-2">
            <RouteFocusModal.Close asChild>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="small">
                {t("actions.cancel")}
              </Button>
            </RouteFocusModal.Close>
            {isLastTab ? (
              <Button
                key="submit-button"
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                size="small"
                isLoading={isPending}
              >
                {t("actions.save")}
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                key="next-button"
                type="button"
                variant="primary"
                size="small"
                onClick={onNext}
              >
                {t("actions.continue")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </RouteFocusModal.Footer>
      </KeyboundForm>
    </RouteFocusModal.Form>
  )
}

/**
 * Details tab: general fields and media only. The create flow also shows the
 * option/variant builder here; the edit flow omits it because options and
 * variants are edited in place (variants tab), not added or removed.
 */
const DetailsTab = ({
  form,
}: {
  form: React.ComponentProps<typeof ProductCreateDetailsForm>["form"]
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { getFormFields } = useExtension()
  const fields = getFormFields("product", "create", "general")

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center p-16">
      <div className="flex w-full max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-y-8">
        <Heading>{t("products.create.header")}</Heading>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-6">
          <ProductCreateGeneralSection form={form} />
          <FormExtensionZone fields={fields} form={form} />
          <ProductCreateMediaSection form={form} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom"

import { RouteFocusModal } from "../../../components/modals"
import { useRegions } from "../../../hooks/api"
import { usePricePreferences } from "../../../hooks/api/price-preferences"
import { useProduct } from "../../../hooks/api/products"
import { useStore } from "../../../hooks/api/store"
import { ProductEditFullForm } from "./components/product-edit-full-form"
import { PRODUCT_EDIT_FULL_FIELDS } from "./utils"

/**
 * Route component for `/products/:id/edit-all`: the full-screen "Edit Product"
 * flow opened from the product detail page.
 *
 * It only loads data and renders the modal shell; the form itself is not
 * rendered until everything it needs has arrived, because the form's default
 * values are computed once on first render.
 */
export const ProductEditFull = () => {
  const { id } = useParams()
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const { product, isPending, isError, error } = useProduct(id!, {
    fields: PRODUCT_EDIT_FULL_FIELDS,
  })

  // Store: supplies the currencies shown as price columns.
  const { store, isPending: isStorePending, isError: isStoreError, error: storeError } =
    useStore()

  // Regions and price preferences: needed for region-specific price columns.
  const {
    regions,
    isPending: isRegionsPending,
    isError: isRegionsError,
    error: regionsError,
  } = useRegions({ limit: 9999 })

  const {
    price_preferences,
    isPending: isPricePreferencesPending,
    isError: isPricePreferencesError,
    error: pricePreferencesError,
  } = usePricePreferences({ limit: 9999 })

  // Surface load failures through the route's error boundary, like the create
  // flow does.
  if (isError) {
    throw error
  }
  if (isStoreError) {
    throw storeError
  }
  if (isRegionsError) {
    throw regionsError
  }
  if (isPricePreferencesError) {
    throw pricePreferencesError
  }

  const ready =
    !!product &&
    !isPending &&
    !!store &&
    !isStorePending &&
    !!regions &&
    !isRegionsPending &&
    !!price_preferences &&
    !isPricePreferencesPending

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal>
      <RouteFocusModal.Title asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.edit.full.title")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Title>
      <RouteFocusModal.Description asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.edit.full.description")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Description>
      {ready && (
        <ProductEditFullForm
          product={product}
          store={store}
          regions={regions}
          pricePreferences={price_preferences}
        />
      )}
    </RouteFocusModal>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"

import { buildProductEditRequests, mapProductToFormValues } from "../utils"

// A small stored product with one variant that has a price, a region price and
// a two-item inventory kit. Cast to `any` because the real API type has many
// required fields the tests do not care about.
const product: any = {
  id: "prod_1",
  title: "Shirt",
  subtitle: null,
  handle: "shirt",
  description: "Old description",
  discountable: true,
  thumbnail: "http://img/1.png",
  width: 10,
  length: null,
  height: null,
  weight: null,
  images: [{ id: "img_1", url: "http://img/1.png" }],
  options: [
    { id: "opt_1", title: "Size", values: [{ id: "val_1", value: "M" }] },
  ],
  tags: [],
  categories: [],
  sales_channels: [{ id: "sc_1", name: "Default" }],
  variants: [
    {
      id: "variant_1",
      title: "M",
      sku: "SHIRT-M",
      variant_rank: 0,
      manage_inventory: true,
      allow_backorder: false,
      options: [{ id: "v1", value: "M", option_id: "opt_1" }],
      prices: [
        { id: "price_1", currency_code: "usd", amount: 10, rules: {} },
        {
          id: "price_2",
          currency_code: "eur",
          amount: 9,
          rules: { region_id: "reg_1" },
        },
      ],
      inventory_items: [
        { inventory_item_id: "iitem_1", required_quantity: 1 },
        { inventory_item_id: "iitem_2", required_quantity: 2 },
      ],
    },
  ],
}

const regionsCurrencyMap = { reg_1: "eur" }

const build = (values: any) =>
  buildProductEditRequests({
    values,
    product,
    media: values.media,
    regionsCurrencyMap,
  })

describe("mapProductToFormValues", () => {
  it("pre-fills product fields, turning nulls and numbers into form strings", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)

    expect(values.title).toBe("Shirt")
    expect(values.subtitle).toBe("")
    expect(values.width).toBe("10")
    expect(values.length).toBe("")
    expect(values.sales_channels).toEqual([{ id: "sc_1", name: "Default" }])
  })

  it("maps options, media and the thumbnail flag", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)

    expect(values.options).toEqual([
      { id: "opt_1", title: "Size", values: ["M"], value_ids: ["val_1"] },
    ])
    expect(values.media).toEqual([
      { id: "img_1", url: "http://img/1.png", isThumbnail: true, file: null },
    ])
  })

  it("maps variant prices by currency/region and detects inventory kits", () => {
    const [variant] = mapProductToFormValues(product).variants

    expect(variant.options).toEqual({ Size: "M" })
    expect(variant.prices).toEqual({ usd: "10", reg_1: "9" })
    expect(variant.inventory_kit).toBe(true)
    expect(variant.inventory).toEqual([
      { inventory_item_id: "iitem_1", required_quantity: "1" },
      { inventory_item_id: "iitem_2", required_quantity: "2" },
    ])
  })
})

describe("buildProductEditRequests", () => {
  it("sends no variant or inventory requests when only product fields change", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)
    values.description = "New description"

    const requests = build(values)

    expect(requests.variantUpdates).toBeUndefined()
    expect(requests.inventoryItems).toBeUndefined()
    expect(requests.product.description).toBe("New description")
  })

  it("clears emptied optional fields with null and converts dimensions", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)
    values.width = ""
    values.height = "5"

    const { product: payload } = build(values)

    expect(payload.subtitle).toBeNull()
    expect(payload.width).toBeNull()
    expect(payload.height).toBe(5)
  })

  it("updates only the changed variant, reusing existing price ids", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)
    values.variants[0].prices = { usd: "12", reg_1: "9" }

    const { variantUpdates } = build(values)

    expect(variantUpdates).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(variantUpdates![0].id).toBe("variant_1")
    expect(variantUpdates![0].prices).toEqual([
      { id: "price_1", currency_code: "usd", amount: 12 },
      {
        id: "price_2",
        currency_code: "eur",
        amount: 9,
        rules: { region_id: "reg_1" },
      },
    ])
  })

  it("diffs inventory kit rows into create, update and delete", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)
    values.variants[0].inventory = [
      // iitem_1 unchanged, iitem_2 removed, iitem_3 added
      { inventory_item_id: "iitem_1", required_quantity: "1" },
      { inventory_item_id: "iitem_3", required_quantity: "4" },
    ]

    const { inventoryItems } = build(values)

    expect(inventoryItems).toEqual({
      create: [
        { variant_id: "variant_1", inventory_item_id: "iitem_3", required_quantity: 4 },
      ],
      update: [],
      delete: [{ variant_id: "variant_1", inventory_item_id: "iitem_2" }],
    })
  })

  it("keeps the thumbnail and image ids from the media list", () => {
    const values = mapProductToFormValues(product)

    const { product: payload } = build(values)

    expect(payload.thumbnail).toBe("http://img/1.png")
    expect(payload.images).toEqual([{ id: "img_1", url: "http://img/1.png" }])
  })
})
```

The Edit Product flow is implemented on `feat/lefecko-issue-8-edit-product-full-flow`, with nothing committed. I haven't run it in a browser yet. The new unit tests pass (8), and the 19 existing and new product tests pass together. Typecheck shows no errors in the files I touched. The errors it does show are existing and unrelated (customers, inventory, `core/types`).

## Where the changes are and what they do

All paths are under `packages/admin/dashboard/src` unless noted.

**New: `routes/products/product-edit-full/`**
- **`product-edit-full.tsx`** is the page for `/products/:id/edit-all`. It loads the product (with variants, prices, options, images, tags and so on), the store, the regions and the price preferences. It shows the full-screen modal only once everything has loaded, because the form's starting values are computed once on first render. Load failures go to the router's error page, as in the create flow.
- **`components/product-edit-full-form/product-edit-full-form.tsx`** is the multi-step form. It copies the create flow's structure: Details, Organize, Variants, and an Inventory tab that appears only when a variant is an inventory kit.
  - **Reused from the create flow:** the schema and the tab components.
  - **Different from create:** the Details tab has only general fields and media, with no option or variant builder. The Organize tab also shows an attributes section for dimensions, material, origin and HS/MID codes.
  - **Footer:** the last tab says "Save", with no "Save as draft".
  - **Leaving early:** the modal's built-in unsaved-changes prompt handles this, so exiting writes nothing.
  - **Save order:** upload new images, update changed variants and prices, update inventory kits, then update the product last.
  - **If a step fails:** it stops, refetches the product, shows an error and keeps the modal open. Earlier steps may already be saved.
  - **On success:** a toast, then back to the detail page.
- **`utils.ts`** holds the pure logic.
  - `mapProductToFormValues` turns a stored product into form values (null becomes `""`, numbers become strings, prices keyed by currency or region, kits detected).
  - `buildProductEditRequests` turns the form values into the API payloads. It skips variants and kits that didn't change, clears emptied fields with `null`, reuses existing price IDs so prices update instead of duplicating, and diffs inventory kits into create, update and delete.
- **`__tests__/utils.spec.ts`** covers the mapping and the payload building.

**Edited**
- **`dashboard-app/routes/get-route.map.tsx`** registers the `edit-all` child route under the product detail route.
- **`routes/products/product-detail/components/product-general-section/product-general-section.tsx`** adds the visible "Edit Product" button in the header, next to the existing ellipsis menu. That menu keeps the quick Edit drawer.
- **`i18n/translations/en.json`** adds the `products.edit.full.*` strings: button, title, description and error toast.

**Repo root**
- **`.changeset/full-product-edit-flow.md`** is the changeset for the dashboard package.

## Things to know before you review
- **Not atomic.** If the variant step succeeds and the product step fails, the variants stay changed. This is the limitation we agreed on, and the error toast tells the user.
- **Status isn't editable here.** The create flow's Publish and Draft buttons set status, and this flow leaves it as is.
- **Shipping profile can't be cleared.** The API has no way to unset it, so it is only sent when set.
- **Not tested end to end.** There's no form-level test for prefill or the discard prompt (the plan listed one), and I haven't run the UI against a backend. To check it by hand, open a product, click Edit Product, change the description, a variant price and the dimensions, then save.
- **Not committed.** Your unrelated changes (`devcontainer-lock.json`, `vite.config.mts`, untracked folders) are still in the working tree and shouldn't go in the commit. Want me to commit just the issue-8 files?

not the test suite, not an `import` of an internal function and a

it: the CLI at its command, the server at its socket, the GUI at its
window.

## First: does a project skill already cover this?

A project skill that launches this app is the repo's verified path -
its author already cold-started from a Linux container and committed
what worked: the exact `apt-get` line, the env vars, the patches, the
driver. Use it instead of rediscovering.

- **One describes launching/driving this app** -> read that SKILL.md

## Otherwise: match the shape, use the pattern

Pick the row closest to your project. Each example walks through
launch + first interaction; ignore any trailing "write the skill"
section - you're using the recipe, not authoring one.

| Project type | Handle | Example |
|---|---|---|
| CLI tool | direct invocation, exit code, stdin/stdout | [examples/cli.md](examples/cli.md) |
| Web server / API | background launch + `curl` smoke | [examples/server.md](examples/server.md) |
| TUI / interactive terminal | tmux `send-keys` / `capture-pane` | [examples/tui.md](examples/tui.md) |
| Electron / desktop GUI | Playwright `_electron` REPL under xvfb | [examples/electron.md](examples/electron.md) |
| Browser-driven | dev server + `chromium-cli` script | [examples/playwright.md](examples/playwright.md) |
| Library / SDK | import-and-call smoke script at the package boundary | [examples/library.md](examples/library.md) |

If nothing fits, start from the closest match and adapt. For a web
app, [examples/playwright.md](examples/playwright.md) - drive it with
`chromium-cli`, no custom driver needed. For a desktop app,
[examples/electron.md](examples/electron.md) - it has the `_electron`
REPL driver skeleton and the tmux wrapping.

## Drive it, don't just launch it

Launching with no interaction proves the entrypoint resolves. That's
not running the app - it's typechecking with extra steps. Drive it to
a point where a user would see something:

- CLI -> type a representative command, check the exit code and output.
- Server -> hit the route the diff touches with `curl`, read the body.
- TUI -> `send-keys` a navigation, `capture-pane` the result.
- GUI -> click the button, screenshot the window. **Look at the
  screenshot.** A blank frame is a failure to launch.

If the fallback pattern didn't work out of the box - you had to
install packages, set env vars, patch config, or write a driver -
recommend `/run-skill-generator` in your report so that work gets
captured as a project skill. If it just worked, don't.

I need to create a new account, how should I do that

---

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 2026-10-26 15:21:21Z)**_

Create an admin user with the Medusa CLI, run from the backend folder. Pick your own email and password:

```
cd my-store/apps/backend
npx medusa user --email you@example.com --password yourpassword
```

You can type that in this session with the `!` prefix: `! cd my-store/apps/backend && npx medusa user --email you@example.com --password yourpassword`. I haven't run it. It writes to your local database.

Then sign in at http://localhost:5173/app/login with that email and password. The running backend doesn't need a restart.

If the command errors, the usual causes are that the database isn't reachable or `.env` is missing. Paste the output and I'll help. If you'd rather I run it, give me the email and password to use.
